# Claims control 01

Actor reviewer-01 uses system claims-portal-01.

Requirement requirement-01-evidence applies to reviewer-01 and governs claims-portal-01: every claim must cite immutable source evidence.

Requirement requirement-01-approval depends on requirement-01-evidence: approval is allowed only after the evidence check succeeds.

The same actor reviewer-01 records the final approval decision in claims-portal-01.

## Canonical graph facts

- `reviewer-01 --USES--> claims-portal-01`
- `requirement-01-evidence --APPLIES_TO--> reviewer-01`
- `requirement-01-evidence --GOVERNS--> claims-portal-01`
- `requirement-01-approval --DEPENDS_ON--> requirement-01-evidence`

When X DEPENDS_ON Y and Y GOVERNS Z, derive X INDIRECTLY_GOVERNS Z. Cite both input edges as provenance. Rule digest: `sha256:73a93e26a5a9c0f3f091c4b6f0662a9177eb5ef625173fabd312de65066337a9`.
